storage.description: Where to store journal data: 'auto', 'persistent', 'volatile', or 'none'

system_max_use.description: Maximum disk space to use for system journal files (e.g., '2G', '10%', '100M')

system_keep_free.description: Minimum free disk space to preserve on the system partition (e.g., '5%', '500M')

system_max_file_size.description: Maximum size per system journal file (e.g., '500M', '2G')

system_max_files.description: Maximum number of system journal files to keep (0 = unlimited)

runtime_max_use.description: Maximum disk space to use for runtime journal files

runtime_keep_free.description: Minimum free space to preserve on /run

runtime_max_file_size.description: Maximum size per runtime journal file

runtime_max_files.description: Maximum number of runtime journal files to keep

max_file_sec.description: Maximum time to retain journal files (e.g., '3days', '6months')

max_retention_sec.description: Maximum age of journal entries overall

compress.description: Whether to compress archived journal files

sync_interval_sec.description: How often to sync journal data to disk (in seconds)

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum messages allowed per rate limit interval

forward_to_syslog.description: Forward journal entries to the system syslog daemon

syslog_socket.description: Path to the syslog socket for forwarding

forward_to_kmsg.description: Forward journal entries to kernel ring buffer

color.description: Enable or disable colorized console output

show_boot_id.description: Include boot ID in console output

seal.description: Enable journal sealing (requires hardware security module)

header_checksum.description: Enable header checksums for integrity verification

boot_ids.description: Maximum number of boot IDs to retain (0 = unlimited)

stream_path.description: Path where journal streaming is available

remote_servers.description: List of remote journal servers to forward entries to

address.description: Hostname or IP address of remote server

audit.description: Enable audit logging to the journal

write_kernel_messages.description: Log kernel messages to the journal

write_service_messages.description: Log service manager messages to the journal

write_user_session_messages.description: Log user session manager messages to the journal
